data.name: Amaraat
data.gender_notes: Amaraat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Islamic history, Amaraat refers to the angels who protect and guard the believers. Their names are mentioned in various Hadiths and are sources of inspiration and comfort. The name Amaraat carries the meaning “The Guardians” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Amaraat usually hope their child will grow to embody the guardians and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of protection, guardianship, and spiritual guidance.
data.etymology: Amaraat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Guardians.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Amaraat total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: أَمَارَاتُ
in_arabic.long_meaning: أَمَارَاتُ: أسماءٌ إسلاميّةٌ مشتقةٌ من الجذر (أ م ر) بمعنى «المُبارَكَاتُ» أو «المَنانَاتُ» وتعني الأماني والمنان والمنزلة، ويشير إلى الطفل الذي يُبارك الله به، ويمنه بالخير والبركة، وأصل الكلمة في اللغة العربية، وتحمل المعاني الكثيرة في الإسلام والتراث العربي، ويُعتبر هذا الاسم من أسماء الطفولة المباركة في الإسلام، وله علاقة بالفعل (أَمَرَ) بمعنى «أَمَرَ» وبالفعل (أَمَرَت) بمعنى «أَمَرَت»

in_urdu.name: امارٹ
in_urdu.long_meaning: امارٹ: ایک اسلامی نام ہے جو عرب کے جذر (أ م ر) سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کے معنی «بارکاتیں» یا «منانتیں» کے ہیں۔ یہ نام طفل کی عرفیت کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے جس پر اللہ تعالیٰ نے برکت نازل کی ہو یا اسے اپنا چننایا ہوا بنایا ہو، یہ نام پاکستانی مسلموں میں بھی بہت مشہور ہے، اور اس کا مطلب ہے کہ اللہ تعالیٰ نے اسے اپنا چننایا ہوا بنایا ہو

data.cultural_impact: The Amaraat are significant in Islamic culture as they represent protection and guardianship of believers. They are mentioned in various Hadiths (collections of the Prophet Muhammad's sayings and actions) and serve as reminders of God's constant care and support for His believers. The belief in these guardian angels provides a sense of security and comfort in daily life, emphasizing the importance of faith and trust in God.
data.spiritual_significance: The Amaraat hold great spiritual significance for Muslims, as they symbolize the presence of divine guidance and protection in their lives. Believers seek the blessings and care of these angels, understanding that they are constantly being watched over and sustained by the mercy and compassion of Allah. The concept of Amaraat also emphasizes the importance of living in accordance with Islamic teachings and striving for spiritual growth, as the angels' protection is not only for the physically Save but also for the soul in the journey towards the hereafter.
